current_evidence: The file at Grokbot's URL (York download 2748, also indexed as 'validation requirements list') is titled 'City of York Council Validation Requirements List' and is dated December 2025 in its text. It replaces the separate 'Validation Requirements List Draft December 2024' consultation file (download 10302).

issues.detail: The list date of 2026-02-01 comes from PDF CreationDate metadata. The document text dates it December 2025.
issues.evidence: Document text: 'City of York Council Validation Requirements List ... December 2025'; reference_row Date basis 'PDF metadata CreationDate'

issues.detail: Grokbot misses many local requirements. Accessibility Statement (major residential full/RM, public buildings, new public spaces); Built Sports Facilities Needs Assessment (loss of built sports facilities, or residential on Strategic Sites); Burial Ground Need Assessment (use of land as burial/memorial ground); Childcare Provision Assessment (loss of or new childcare facilities, strategic/allocated residential sites); Community Facilities Assessment (loss of community land/facilities, all strategic residential sites); Cultural Wellbeing Plan (strategic sites); Demolition and/or Construction Environment Management Plan (draft) (major schemes and others with air, noise or traffic impacts during works); Delivery and Servicing Management Plan (draft) (schemes generating significant deliveries/servicing); Economic Statement (loss of employment land/buildings).
issues.evidence: Local validation requirements section of the December 2025 list

issues.detail: More local requirements are missing. Foul Sewage (major developments connecting to the foul network); Habitats Regulation Assessment (development near Strensall Common SAC or affecting a European site; only partial policy text appears in tab_items); Healthcare Services (loss of primary/secondary care); Healthy Places Statement (major residential incl. communal establishments); Housing Statement (new residential of 1+ dwellings); Local Affordable Housing Need Assessment (rural exception sites in the Green Belt); Masterplan (strategic sites); Student Housing Need Assessment (off-campus PBSA); Sustainability and Energy Statement (new residential, non-residential 1,000 sq m+, conversions/changes of use, strategic sites); Transport Statement (major residential 10-49 units, or schemes increasing traffic/parking).
issues.evidence: Local validation requirements section of the December 2025 list

issues.detail: Grokbot attaches the next requirement's trigger to several items. Tree Survey/Arboricultural Report: 'All strategic sites' is the Travel Plan trigger; the source says trees on or next to the site that could be affected. Coal Mining: given 'loss of ... facilities in a community use' (Community Facilities trigger); source says Development High Risk Areas. Crime prevention: given 'significant number of deliveries' (Delivery & Servicing trigger); source says all major applications and ATMs. SCI: given 'Purpose Built Student Accommodation' (Student Housing trigger); source says all major. Transport Assessment: given 'masts and/or antennae' (Telecoms trigger); source says major residential over 50 units, major commercial, and schools/hospitals/places of worship.
issues.evidence: e.g. 'Travel Plan Tree Survey / Arboricultural Report When is it required? All strategic sites;'

issues.detail: Other triggers are garbled or misstated. Self-build: the excerpt is the retail 2,500 sq m impact threshold; the source says developments with more than one self/custom build plot. Viability: the excerpt is about flues; the source says applications failing affordable housing policy on viability grounds, including S73s. Planning Statement: given 'All major applications' (the Landscaping trigger); the source says most applications except householder, flat extensions, adverts, prior approvals and discharge of conditions. Drainage/SuDS: only further-guidance links; the source says major and minor except householder under 50 sq m and changes of use. Open space/play: the excerpt is Planning Statement text.
issues.evidence: Self-build row: 'For out of centre proposals of 2500sqm gross floorspace and above, an impact assessment is also required'

issues.detail: 'Tall buildings / Wind microclimate assessment' does not exist in York's list. The excerpt is the sections drawing scale note. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is the fragment 'part of pre-application advice;'.
issues.evidence: 'site or tall building What is required? be at a scale of 1:50 or 1:100 (for major applications 1:200 may be acceptable)'

issues.detail: 'Lawful development evidence (statutory declarations etc.)' sits under Full planning, while the Lawful development cert row says 'none'. The source has dedicated LDC lists. Proposed: form, location plan, fee, evidence of lawfulness. Existing: suggested evidence such as redacted council tax/utility/tenancy records and sworn affidavits.
issues.evidence: Source LDC (existing use) list: council tax bills, utility bills, sworn affidavits

issues.detail: Fire Statement under Listed building consent is wrong. The source applies it to full planning for relevant buildings with 2+ dwellings or educational accommodation that are 18m+ or 7+ storeys, and Grokbot's excerpt is actually the LBC Design and Access Statement text. Health Impact Assessment appears only under Outline/Reserved matters, though the source also requires it for full applications on strategic sites. Under Change of use - prior approval, Grokbot gives the general site/block plan and sections, but the source's prior notification list (larger home extensions) needs a written description with dimensions, site plan and adjoining addresses.
issues.evidence: 'Fire Statement: full planning applications involving relevant buildings ... 18m+ or 7+ storeys'; 'Health Impact Assessment: Outline, full and reserved matters applications for strategic sites'

issues.detail: Grokbot ignores the source's application-type checklists. Advertisement consent says 'none', but the source needs existing elevations/photos, advert drawings with colours, materials and illumination, sections showing fixing, and a heritage statement. Non-material amendment and S73 say 'none', but the source needs a marked-up composite of the approved plans, plus a draft S106 in track changes for S73 where an S106 exists. Householder has only floor plans/elevations, although the household checklist adds a heritage statement and CIL forms.
issues.evidence: Source checklists: 'Advertisement Consent', 'Non-material amendments (S96a) and minor material amendments (S73)', 'Household and minor'

issues.detail: About 38 general-list requirements are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' (e.g. Telecoms, Retail Impact, Schedule of works (listed building)), even though the source names the application types and thresholds in each 'When is it required?' box.
issues.evidence: notes: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list; placed under Full planning'

issues.detail: The 'Submission rules' tab items are mostly contact and process text: the planning.submissions email and postal address, validation team steps (acknowledgement letter, neighbour letters, press adverts), the fee refund 'minus an administration fee', and pre-application service text.
issues.evidence: 'The validation team create a list of neighbours to notify and letters are sent (if appropriate);'

issues.detail: The reference row's 'Planning page' is the generic york.gov.uk homepage, not a planning or validation page.

summary: Grokbot's York link is the current December 2025 list, but it dated the list 2026-02-01 from PDF metadata. About 19 local requirements are missing (e.g. Accessibility, Housing, Sustainability/Energy, Foul Sewage, HRA, Masterplan), many triggers belong to the next requirement in the PDF, and the source's type-specific checklists (LDC, adverts, S73/NMA, prior notification) were ignored.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
